entities.name: Query protein (768 aa)
observations: 768-aa query has strong homology to reviewed bacterial NADH-quinone oxidoreductase subunit B/C/D proteins (40% identity; >90% query coverage).

Homolog annotations describe NDH-1 electron transfer from NADH via FMN and Fe-S centers to quinone, coupled to proton translocation; exact subunit identity and quinone species for this query remain unconfirmed.

entities.name: NADH:quinone reduction
observations: Rhea RHEA:57888: quinone + NADH + 5 H+(in) = quinol + NAD+ + 4 H+(out), as reported for homologous NDH-1 proteins.
